## Summary

Describe the problem, approach, and any relevant evidence or risk.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests were added or updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes.
- [ ] Deterministic `python -m pytest` passes.
- [ ] Docker validation was run or considered and applicability is explained.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, tokens, Playwright storage state, or authenticated browser artifacts are committed.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where required.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out trust-boundary changes, generated-code execution changes, external dependencies, and any validation not performed.
